widgets_values: Redraw <image1> as a printed black-and-white manga page panel, as if inked by the original artist for serialization. Keep the exact composition, pose, character design, face, expression and drawing style of <image1>. Use confident ink lines with varied line weight, solid black for dark hair and deep shadows, white paper for skin and light surfaces, ink hatching lines for shadows on cloth, and regular screentone only where a mid tone is needed. No color and no smooth gradients. Do not add anything that is not in <image1>.

Keep every line and every black area exactly where it is in <image1>, with the same shapes and the same thickness. Clean up jagged, fuzzy and broken edges, remove stray specks, dots and noise, and close small gaps in the lines. Pure black and white only: no grey, no screentone, no shading, no hatching that is not in <image1>, and do not add anything that is not in <image1>.

nodes.title: Edit instruction B
widgets_values:
Bolder edit instruction: dark colours go solid black. Paste it into "Edit instruction" and set black_point to 0.40.

Redraw <image1> as a printed black-and-white manga page panel, as if inked by the original artist for serialization. Keep the exact composition, pose, character design, face, expression and drawing style of <image1>. Use confident ink lines with varied line weight. Decide every area as paper white, screentone, or solid black ink: anything that is dark or black in color in <image1> (dark clothing, dark hair, deep shadows) is filled with solid black ink, with its folds and seams left as thin white lines; skin and light surfaces stay white paper; mid colors become flat screentone. No grey gradients, no soft airbrushed shading, no color. Do not add anything that is not in <image1>.

nodes.title: How stage 2 works
widgets_values:
Stage 2: Qwen Image redraws the solid layer as clean line art + solid black.

Manga Solid Refine then:
- turns the redraw into the new solid layer (threshold, edge_softness, despeckle)
- finds what was solid before but is not solid now
- fills that area in light_tone / dark_tone with the surrounding gradation (tone_fill)
- fill_floor keeps vanished black masses as tone even when the surroundings are white

If Qwen moves lines or changes details, change the seed or make the instruction stricter.
